Identified Deficiencies

IA-2 — Multi-factor authentication is not enforced for all privileged accounts

Critical
Recommended Remediation
Enforce phishing-resistant MFA for every privileged account and disable password-only authentication paths.
Owner
IAM Team · milestone 31 July 2026

AU-6 — Audit records are collected but not reviewed on a defined cadence

High
Recommended Remediation
Implement a documented daily audit-review procedure with alerting on security-relevant events.
Owner
Security Operations · milestone 31 August 2026

SC-28 — Sensitive data is not encrypted at rest in the analytics store

High
Recommended Remediation
Enable storage-level encryption with managed keys and validate via configuration testing.
